STRANGER THAN HEAVEN is a fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan. Coming to PlayStation 5 on January 15, 2027. 

In this trailer, discover the events that lead Makoto Daito to sneak aboard the ship of a man named Orpheus, and the harsh realities and life-changing encounters that await him once arriving in the city of Kokura, Japan.

Additional trailers spotlighting Daito's life in each of the five cities and eras featured throughout the game will be released in the future. Stay tuned for more.

To join up with the Royal Academy Expedition Team on its mission to explore the uncharted lands to the north and rebuild the region’s defences so that it’s citizens may once again live in peace and harmony with nature.

Fortunately, Whitewall’s skilled artisans are here to help!
